kypExtensions.summary: The pattern/trap/pivot/mini-case attack structure layered over the source facts.
kypExtensions.rationale: First Aid supplies the CLaSH rule, the 4-hematogenous-carcinoma exception list, and the 4-row site-of-metastasis table; the attack structure is a KYP design.

kypExtensions.summary: The two-axis rule (the route axis: CLaSH + 4 hematogenous-carcinoma exceptions; the tropism axis: the 4 site-of-metastasis rows with the bone blastic/mixed/lytic fork) — KYP's synthesis of the page into one reading protocol.
kypExtensions.rationale: The source prints the rule and the table sequentially without a unified protocol; the framing is KYP's design.

kypExtensions.summary: The four KYP mnemonics (CLaSH / FOUR HEMATOGENOUS CARCINOMAS / BLASTIC MIXED LYTIC / MULTIPLE METASTASES LONE PRIMARY) — no mnemonic prints on the page beyond the CLaSH acronym (which is the source's own).
kypExtensions.rationale: Only the CLaSH acronym prints on book 219 (the source's own); the other three codes are KYP's design. The CLaSH acronym is attributed to the source.
